item.title: Gillette sees light snow today before weekend warmup
item.description: GILLETTE, Wyo. — Light snow will taper off today in Campbell County, with little additional accumulation expected in Gillette and surrounding areas, according to the National Weather Service in Rapid City, South Dakota.
